## Research

Game theory and the economics of information, including repeated games, bounded rationality, and applications to finance and insurance.

[Working papers and publications](papers/index.qmd)

[SInfoNiA](sinfonia/index.qmd) — awarded an ERC Advanced Grant in 2024; funded by UKRI.
